name: Pyraminx in Pewaukee 2026
information:
This is the 4th annual Pyraminx in Pewaukee! We are excited to see many new and returning faces here in Pewaukee again!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4ODM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--74d430e914c8b5d2ce07dfd1635fed76673e07f6/pip4-small.jpg)

New to competing? This competition is a good one to be your first!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
